llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward PoYo Gemini API helper that discloses its external API calls and API-key requirement.

dimensions.detail: The helper script sends a user-supplied JSON payload and bearer token to https://api.poyo.ai, which is expected for this API skill but means users should only send data they intend to share with PoYo.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency fetch, package install, or setup hook was found; metadata only declares curl and POYO_API_KEY as requirements.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to Gemini 3 model selection, payload construction, streaming/native formats, and response handling; the skill explicitly says not to make live API calls unless the user asks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, scheduled tasks, privilege escalation, local credential-store reads, or broad filesystem indexing were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to help prepare and optionally submit PoYo Gemini chat requests; the documented endpoints, payload examples, curl helper, and POYO_API_KEY requirement fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use PoYo's Gemini API. Keep POYO_API_KEY server-side, review payload files before submitting them, and avoid sending private prompts, inline media, or secrets unless your policy allows sharing them with PoYo.
llm.findings:
[P2] unexpected: The reported hidden content is a UTF-8 BOM at the start of SKILL.md, not a hidden instruction or prompt override.
[PE3] expected: The referenced text points users to PoYo's API-key page and recommends an environment variable; it does not read credential files.
[E1] expected: External POST examples and the curl script target the disclosed PoYo API endpoint, which is central to the skill's purpose.
[SQP-2] expected: The script lacks an inline confirmation prompt, but SKILL.md documents that it submits chat payloads and restricts live calls to explicit user request from a trusted shell.
